notes.title: DG2 April 2018 Update
notes.content:
PC
•	Fixed the dreaded crash that could occur when rewinding!
•	Fixed a bug that prohibited entry into the Custom Levels screen
•	Fixed a crash involving the Tesla tower
•	Fixed a crash that could occur when closing the Settings screen
•	Fixed a crash that could occur in the Mission Summary screen
•	Fixed a number of crashes and bugs in DG Architect
•	Fixed a bug where particle effects would sometimes briefly appear at the world origin


Linux and Mac
•	The Linux and Mac builds have not been updated
•	Support for Linux and Mac is being sunsetted going forward

notes.title: 5/22/2015 DG2 May Steam Update - PC & Mac. No UCC support for Linux/SteamOS.
notes.content:
[b]DG2 May Steam Update - PC only (Mac soon)[/b]
 
[list][*]DGArchitect custom scripts now support all game modes

[*]DGArchitect maps can now include Classic Open mode scoring

[*]DG Architect ray tracing bug fixed that prevented block properties from being selected

[*]DG Architect Point lights now appear in DG Architect

[*]Classic Open string entries updated or added

[*]For the PC & Mac update, UCC formats needed to change making them unusable on Linux.  We hope to change this in the future, but it may take longer than desired because of some conflicting Linux issues.

[/list]

notes.title: 3/24/2015 - DG2 March Steam Update - PC, Mac only (SteamOS version coming very soon)
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Game Type: Classic Open.[/b]  Classic Open introduces the original DG scoring model to DG2.  It is available for all single player missions and modes. No medals are awarded in Classic Open.
[*][b]Tower Limit Mode Fix:[/b] Fixed bug in which boost towers could automatically sell out from underneath a tower in the middle of upgrading.
[*][b]Strategy Camera Added:[/b]  Edge scrolling camera for single player can be toggled on / off using Shift+C or can be set to be the default by adding “-freecamera” to the Steam launch options (library, right-click->properties, set launch options)
[/list]
 
[b]Stability:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed top ten crash bugs responsible for majority of remaining reported game crashes.
[*]Fixed a significant number of OpenGL rendering issues for Mac (and soon SteamOS) improving both quality and performance rendering
[*]Fixed Mac launcher race condition where launcher might not appear while Steam is still initializing launch of game
[*]Fixed multiple DG Architect crash bugs
[*]Fixed DG Architect block thumbnails not appearing
[/list]
 
[b]Leaderboard Validity:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added ability to remove scores from leaderboards that aren’t possible to achieve in an unaltered game session
[*]Removal of invalid scores will take place some days after update release
[/list]
 
[b]User Created Content (UCC) Tools Enhancement:[/b]
[list]
[*]New UCC file format – must have update to download new UCC maps
[*]Enabled UCC maps to have story mode leaderboards
[*]Enabled UCC script asset creation with DG Architect and game loading of that script
[*]Enabled UCC script assets to be packaged in Steam Workshop upload
[*]Stopped UCC map creation process from creating multiple leaderboard versions for the same map
[*]Mac: Users can load custom levels now. Custom levels are looked for here:  /Users/<user_name>/Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/<steam_user_id>/221540/local/DG2/<custom_map_folder>
[/list]
 
[b]Usability[/b]
[list]
[*]Restored Mouse button bindings to match system settings in Windows

notes.title: Mac version updated!
notes.content:
This small update fixes a few known issues and new problems reported by users since yesterday's release.

- Fixed issues with some Nvidea cards.  If you previously added the -forwardshading option to the Defense Grid 2 launch options in Steam, you can remove that now.
- Fixed an issue in which OS X 10.7.5 could cause the game to crash.
- Defense Grid 2 should now be code signed so that it no longer causes OS X to warn the user that the application is untrusted on Mavericks, depending on user settings.
- Fix for situations in which the Defense Grid 2 launcher web page was appearing in the user's default browser.  If you still experience this problem, please let us know!

notes.title: Mac and Linux versions are here!
notes.content:
The Mac and Linux versions are here!

We are still looking into the known issues and will update the builds as needed.  Enjoy!

If you have the previous version of the Mac or Linux builds, please be sure to completely uninstall before updating to the latest version.

Known issues:
- Players cannot type in the chat field during a multiplayer session, but Steam chat will still function.
- Players using a gamepad may see their mouse cursor vanish temporarily if they open a Steam menu with the gamepad.
- Defense Grid 2 may crash on shutdown.  This is a non-destructive crash and will not incur data loss.
- Crossplatform multiplayer matchmaking is not yet function.
- Crossplatform multiplayer games will function via game invites, but there may be odd or buggy behavior.
- [Mac only] There are some issues with Nvidea video cards that can cause rendering problems with shadows, fog, and visual effects.  A workaround is to add -forwardshading to the Launch Options within Steam.  This will reduce overall visual quality but will be an improvement if you experience these issues.

notes.title: An October Update
notes.content:
We have a new DG2 update for you this week in early October.  It comes with some new functionality and game improvements as well as bug and crash fixes.  We hope you enjoy!

New functionality:

- Actual Full screen mode now supported (works properly with multi-monitor setups).
- Windowed mode at native resolution will hide title bar and edges as before
- Mouse cursor fast double clicking now supported
- Three state toggle now for path indicator – none, regular, large & bright
- Added notification string (currently only in English) if player is on a system below the DirectX10 minimum
- Support Gamepad on launcher for full Big Picture mode support
- FXAA (anti-aliasing) now supported.
- Traditional and Simplified Chinese localization now available.

Improvements:

- Top 10 detected crash fixes addressed
- Significant graphics performance increases depending on video card
- Particle performance improved, especially at low frame rates
- Graph drawing fixes when showing score graphs
- Adjusted alien scripts for Missions 7, 8, 10 & 12 based on player metrics collected
- Fixed Mission 8 Focal Point medal requirements: bronze & gold medal were previously the same
- Removed DG1 cheat codes used for development
- Additional UI clean up fixes
- Some level editor bug fixes

notes.title: Weekend Update
notes.content:
Some DG2 Fixes for Your Weekend:  Today we're releasing an update that helps increase launcher performance and fixes several bugs. 

- Launcher now loads locally and only a few elements are populated when an online connection is present
- Local multiplayer mouse fixes implemented
- Korean language support reinstated and working again
- Crash bugs during multiplayer invite loading fixed
- Fast forward keyboard remapping now saved
